notes: Eclipse Loop 1.7.2 Follow-up polish to 1.7.0. - The velocity lane has its own toggle. It used to be always on in piano-roll mode with no way to hide it, so on a track with no notes it read as dead space. VEL LANE in the tool strip — or View → Velocity Lane — shows and hides it, the same way the CC lane works. Hiding it gives the space back to the roll instead of leaving a blank strip. - The velocity tool is now VELO, so it is not confused with the lane toggle beside it. One changes what a drag does; the other shows a strip. - A mixer send that is off now looks off. "off" was drawn dimmer and smaller than a live send value, which buried the one thing it exists to make obvious. - Fixed in 1.7.1, included here: the empty black band above the pads in sequencer mode.
